description: Bauleitplanung und Kanal Amt Dänischer Wohld (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by service.gdi-sh.de. All valid development, land use and landscape plans of the municipalities of the Danish Welfare Office as well as channel data and broadband empty pipes. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Architectural planning and canal office Danish Wohld (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Dänischer Wohld, Schinkel, opendata, infoCoverageAccessService, Tüttendorf, Lindau. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
